summary: Completed backend + frontend testing for ATS-Lite. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests passed (auth register/login/me, JWT validation, jobs CRUD, status workflow, filter/search/pagination, user scoping). Frontend: login -> dashboard, Add Job dialog creates jobs, stats/filter tabs render, job card shows. Status option dropdown selector (status-option-<id>-Interview) did not appear after clicking status-dropdown-trigger - likely wrapped in Popover portal.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking data-testid=status-dropdown-trigger-<id>, the status option [data-testid=status-option-<id>-Interview] was not found in DOM within 500ms. May be rendered in a portal not queried, or using different testid format. Worth verifying manually.

action_items: Verify JobCard status dropdown renders options with data-testid='status-option-<id>-<Status>' when opened - if in a portal/popover, testing agent could not find it by simple query_selector. Main agent should confirm selector format matches the review_request spec.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec (browsers reject). Works now because backend uses Bearer tokens not cookies, but should be set to explicit origins if cookies are used.
Backend uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
seed_admin correctly re-hashes password if changed (idempotent) - good.
bcrypt hashes verified, JWT HS256 with 7-day expiry, emails lowercased on insert and lookup - good.
User scoping on /api/jobs uses created_by == user.id (verified via cross-user 404 test) - good.
JobUpdate uses exclude_unset + strips None so clients can patch partial fields safely.
test_credentials: admin@example.com / admin123 (seeded). Dynamic users registered via /api/auth/register during tests.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_* users and jobs created via API; jobs cleaned up implicitly via delete tests but not all.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Only one frontend concern: status option popover selectors. Rest of UI flows (login, register, add job, filter tabs, stats, pagination, logout path) use data-testid values that match the request.
